workload.useful_operation: One real CLOCK query inside two CLOCK endpoint probes; identical useful operation and oracle in recorder OFF and ON. Interval is not pure syscall latency.

measurement.clock: AArch64 generic architectural counter through native CLOCK; QEMU TCG

sampling.stopping_rule: Three fresh pairs per profile, OFF/ON then ON/OFF then OFF/ON; four retained warmups and 24 samples per boot. Twelve total DEV/PROD boots. No retry, selective omission, historical reuse or success-dependent stop. Boots are repeat units; within-boot observations may correlate.

overhead.collection_method: Same three CLOCK calls and oracle in both modes. ON adds fixed intermediate-snapshot buffer stores inside the envelope; OFF omits only those stores. Retain matched raw arrays; cost is incremental recorder overhead, not all timestamp probes; never subtract an exact correction.

metrics.definition: Descriptive nearest-rank median of OFF endpoint architectural-counter deltas around one useful CLOCK query and common bookkeeping; oracle checks follow the end snapshot; excludes REPORT export and does not isolate pure syscall or exclusive CPU cost.
metrics.denominator: one useful CLOCK query inside a three-CLOCK envelope

methodologies.section: 1.2 and 1.3: validation, disclosure and reproducibility principles
TOE/SPD/SFR/SAR conceptual model; no normative component mapping
Data quality and validation of measures

security.toe: Existing read-only current-process CLOCK ABI, external measurement actor/oracle and retained Arena evidence admission.

spd.attacker_model: Malformed or incomplete actor reports and altered retained evidence are supplied to the host importer; malicious kernel or fully forged custody chain is outside scope.
threats: Invalid, omitted or unfinished useful operation falsely admitted as a successful observation.
Changed provenance or missing required evidence accepted; observation incorrectly treated as access authority.
assumptions: Trusted immutable boot inputs and working declared QEMU counter/frequency.
Existing scheduler exception isolation; exact source/image identity is retained, not cryptographically attested.
policies: CLOCK is read-only current-process observation and needs no invented device or IPC authorization grant.
Failed, truncated or unverifiable runs cannot qualify as successful measurements.
boundaries: No kernel instrumentation or source mutation; actor runs through the existing public ABI.
No secret noninterference, physical hardware, vulnerability certification, PMU or broad reliability/fuzz claim.

sfr.claim: Actual useful CLOCK observations satisfy fixed frequency, ordering and checked-delta oracle; normal root completion and reclamation are witnessed.
Exact-source review establishes the unchanged read-only current-process boundary; malformed or incomplete observations, failed mandatory requirements and absent evidence cannot qualify for admission.

sar.scope: Fresh DEV/PROD actor reports with one useful query per envelope, exact report/exit/reclamation and checked partial attribution; no broad scheduler correctness inference.
External invalid-input and retained-evidence cases for omitted operation/broken oracle, loss or corruption, mandatory SFR failure and missing SAR; no production corruption.
Independent exact-source review of CLOCK, SDK, actor and oracle; no new authority, selector, kernel probe or resource-lifetime change.

security.ava_van_scope: Not evaluated; bounded oracle/source review is not a vulnerability analysis.
security.attack_potential_scope: Not evaluated; no AP level or certification asserted.
